person: a best friend who moved away
shape: some people feel like a cosy everyday comparison

slides.text: some people feel like the second stool at the kitchen counter: two train changes away, but [[nobody else gets to sit there]].

caption:
we haven't lived in the same town since twenty-two, but my spare room is still basically yours.
having a best friend in another city just means half your life is permanently parked by their kettle.
send this to the one who still calls you from the supermarket aisle to ask which pasta you used to buy.

#friendshipquotes #bestfriendquotes #longdistancefriendship
alt: a small green donkey sits quietly on the floor next to text about a best friend who moved away.
